上.meaning: A <part>faucet</part> stands on a <part>one</part>-plank floor and sprays straight up like a fountain. The water shoots higher than the roof and rains down on the birds flying <kanji>above</kanji>.
上.on: A <sound>jo</sound>ey jumps out of its mother's pouch and rides the fountain high into the air.
上.kun: '<sound>Ooh</sound>! <sound>Eh</sound>?' says a bird up above, as the spray hits its tail feathers.

牛.meaning: Two bars on a tall post, and a little slash poking up on top like one bent horn. Stare at it across the field and it stares right back, chewing slowly, then lets out a long moo. It's a <kanji>cow</kanji>.
牛.on: Two farmers ar<sound>gue</sound> about whose cow is louder, and the cow moos over both of them.
牛.kun: '<sound>Ooh</sound>, <sound>shee</sound>p!' says the cow, and trots off to join the flock.

物.meaning: A <part>cow</part> grabs a <part>broom</part> and sweeps out the barn. Out of the straw come all sorts of things: a boot, a spoon, a lost key, a clock. The cow piles them up and calls each one a <kanji>thing</kanji>.
物.on: The first thing it sweeps up is a toy <sound>bu</sound>ll, and the dust makes the cow sneeze: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!'
物.kun: A <sound>mo</sound>le pops out of the pile of things and squeaks: '<sound>No</sound>, those are mine!'

気.meaning: <part>Steam</part> curls up from a hot bath, and a pair of <part>scissors</part> hides inside it, blades open in a tiny X. Snip, snip: they cut the steam into the shape of a ghost, which sighs happily and drifts about. You can't see it, but you can feel its <kanji>spirit</kanji>.
気.on: The ghost unlocks the bathroom door with a brass <sound>key</sound> and drifts out in the steam.
気.kun: The spirit hums one high note, '<sound>Kee</sound>!', and the steam swirls around it.

入.meaning: Two strokes lean in and touch at the top: a narrow <part>entrance</part>, just big enough to squeeze through. Duck your head, turn sideways and slide in. You have found the way to <kanji>enter</kanji>.
入.on: Inside the narrow door, a waiter hands you a me<sound>nu</sound> as long as your arm.
入.kun: '<sound>Hi</sound>!' says someone already inside, as you squeeze in through the door.

乗.meaning: A tall stalk of <part>grain</part> has a <part>one</part>-plank seat nailed across its stem, with little footrests sticking out each side. A mouse climbs on, grabs the drooping top like reins, and off the stalk sways across the field. Hop on and <kanji>ride</kanji>!
乗.on: A <sound>jo</sound>ey hops on behind the mouse, and the grain stalk bends almost to the ground.
乗.kun: '<sound>No</sound>!' squeaks the mouse, as the joey's mother tries to climb on too.

用.meaning: Nobody throws out this old <part>fence</part> panel. Hang coats on its bars, prop it up as a shelf, lay it flat as a bridge over a puddle. Whatever the job, you find a way to <kanji>utilize</kanji> it.
用.on: Hang a <sound>yo</sound>-yo from one of its bars, and the fence is a toy too.
用.kun: The fence panel even works as a tray for a row of sticky <sound>mochi</sound> cakes.

通.meaning: Someone drops a giant <part>padlock</part> at the top of the <part>ramp</part>, and every driver slows down to stare. Horns honk, cars inch round it one by one, and soon they're stuck nose to tail all the way down. It's rush-hour <kanji>traffic</kanji>.
通.on: Exhaust fumes everywhere: one driver lets out a long, slow sneeze, '<sound>Tsooo</sound>!', that rattles every window in the jam.
通.kun: A car rolls over your <sound>toe</sound> as it finally squeezes through.
